concept: RDS Multi-AZ: automatic failover with no data loss
tests: Distinguishing Multi-AZ (HA, synchronous standby) from Read Replicas/snapshots.
expected: Enable Multi-AZ — synchronous standby in another AZ, automatic failover with no data loss. Triggers: "automatic failover to another AZ", "no data loss", "production".
why_not: Read Replicas are asynchronous (data loss possible) and promoted manually — that is read scaling/DR; hourly snapshots are backup, not failover.
